metadata.title: Cinquantenaire Scientifique de M. Henry Le Chatelier

typographie_suggestion.explanation: The typeface features a strong contrast between thick and thin strokes, vertical stress, and relatively flat, unbracketed serifs, which are characteristic of the late 18th and early 19th-century French neoclassical styles (similar to Didot or Bodoni).
